messages.O perturbație se transmite din aproape î: A disturbance travels from particle to particle at a finite speed. The source or centre of oscillation is where the external disturbance is applied. messages.Două puncte sunt în fază dacă au permane: Two points are in phase if their oscillation vectors remain equal and change in the same way: displacements increase or decrease together. Equal displacement at just one instant is insufficient.
messages.Lungimea de undă λ este distanța, pe dir: Wavelength λ is the distance along propagation between neighbouring points of equal phase, for example successive crests or troughs. A is amplitude, T period, ν frequency and ω angular frequency.

Rays are perpendicular to these surfaces and indicate propagation. The wavefront is the wave surface farthest from the source at the chosen time.
In one period T, phase advances by λ. Phase speed depends on medium elasticity and inertia; the period is set by the source. Wavelength depends on both. Propagation speed is distinct from particle oscillation velocity.

messages.Capătul stâng este fix. Nodurile au elon: The left end is fixed. Nodes always have zero displacement, and antinodes have amplitude 2A.
messages.Sunt afișate cele două componente de pro: Both travelling components and their sum are shown. A fixed end inverts the pulse; a free end reflects it without inversion.
messages.Diagrama corzii; derulare orizontală pe: String diagram; scroll horizontally on a phone
messages.A este amplitudinea fiecărei unde progre: A is the amplitude of each travelling wave; the resultant amplitude is 2A|sin(2πx/λ)|. The harmonic standing wave is already established.
messages.La prima întâlnire cu capătul drept, com: At the first encounter with the right end, the right-moving component is incident and the left-moving component is reflected. After later reflections, colours continue to identify propagation direction. A reflected pulse is not a standing wave.
messages.Animație încetinită: fundamentala se ved: Slowed animation: the fundamental is displayed at 0.2 Hz. Readouts show physical frequency and time.
messages.Animație încetinită: o traversare L/v_f: Slowed animation: one L/v_f crossing takes 1.5 s on screen. The slider covers four crossings; the displayed time is physical time.
messages.durează 1,5 s pe ecran. Sliderul acoperă: crossing takes 1.5 s on screen. The slider covers four crossings; the displayed time is physical time.
messages.Schimbarea parametrilor reîncepe experim: Changing parameters restarts the experiment paused. Model: an ideal uniform, perfectly elastic string, with small transverse oscillations and no losses.
messages.Capătul liber alunecă vertical pe un ghi: The free end slides vertically on a frictionless guide; transverse force is zero. During the first reflection, endpoint displacement can reach 2A.
messages.Elongațiile sunt amplificate vizual; axe: Displacements are visually magnified; the axes use different scales.
Fixed end: node and inverted reflection. Free end: antinode in a standing mode and non-inverted reflection.
messages.A este amplitudinea fiecărei unde progre: A is the amplitude of each travelling wave; resultant antinodes have amplitude 2A. The harmonic standing wave is already established.
messages.Constructivă: Δr = nλ ; Distructivă: Δr: Constructive: Δr = nλ ; Destructive: Δr = (2n+1)λ/2 ; n = 0,1,2,…
messages.Protocol general laborator avansat: 1) S: General advanced-laboratory protocol: 1) Sonometer: check f² versus T linearity; slope p = 1/(4μL²). 2) Kundt: find resonance, measure d=λ/2 and use v=2df. 3) Oscilloscope: estimate 440 Hz by autocorrelation. 4) Seismic: trigger the schematic event, measure Δt and estimate hypocentral distance dₕ=Δt·vP·vS/(vP−vS) in the constant-speed model. Observe that S waves do not propagate through liquid; triangulate the epicentre with three stations and known focal depth.

messages.P reproduce oscilația sursei la timpul t: P reproduces the source oscillation at time t − τ. The simulation shows an established harmonic wave. If the source starts at t = 0, P remains at rest until the wave arrives at t = τ.
messages.x = L/2: mijlocul corzii: x = L/2: midpoint of the string
messages.Saltul de fază la reflexie și drumul ech: Reflection phase shift and equivalent path
messages.Pentru o componentă armonică: Δs este dr: For a harmonic component: Δs is the phase-equivalent path, not an extra distance travelled by the pulse.
messages.La pornire, sursa din x = 0 emite un sin: On start, the source at x = 0 emits one pulse, then returns to rest and clamps the left end. Reset brings the entire string to rest.
messages.s(t) este deplasarea prescrisă a sursei: s(t) is the prescribed source displacement only during emission; it is zero before and after emission. A permanently fixed endpoint cannot generate the pulse by itself.
messages.A oscilează vertical; perturbația se pro: A oscillates vertically; the disturbance travels towards B. Ahead of the wavefront, the string remains at rest.
messages.Etapă a propagării; derulare orizontală: Propagation stage; scroll horizontally on narrow screens
messages.A este sursa. B este capătul îndepărtat;: A is the source. B is the far end; the wavefront has not reached B. The vertical arrow indicates source oscillation and the horizontal arrow propagation.
messages.Într-o perioadă, sursa revine la aceeași: In one period, the source returns to the same phase and the wavefront advances by one wavelength.
The final frame continues to 5T/4. The incident wave is shown before reaching end B; reflection is studied separately.
messages.Ultimul cadru continuă evoluția după pri: The final frame continues the evolution after the first period. The incident wave is shown before reaching end B; reflection is studied separately.
